motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of Council be held on Wednesday, February 1, 2023 immediately following adjournment of the open session in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to litigation.
motions.text_html:
That a closed meeting of Council be held on Wednesday, February 1, 2023 immediately following adjournment of the open session in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:

  1. Receiving advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege related to litigation.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 5:08 p.m.
